title: California's AG subpoenas Nvidia to investigate whether Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China getting advanced chips, and whether Nvidia misled investors (Katie Nicora/CBS News)
summary: Katie Nicora / CBS News: California's AG subpoenas Nvidia to investigate whether Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China getting advanced chips, and whether Nvidia misled investors — California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced an investigative subpoena on chipmaker Nvidia on Thursday following allegations …
